description: Head-movement mini-game G11: rhythm-nod game, voice-guided. Four slow count-in beats, then 16 scored beats one second apart at a fixed tempo; nod gently inside plus or minus 300 ms of a beat to hit it. Early, late and missed beats are called aloud, one nod per beat only. Small slow nods, no circling, no jerking, no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: rhythm-nod
